{{Top|leg}}
The '''Nematiec Gang''' was an organization active in the years leading up to the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. At some point before [[3999 BBY]], their asteroid base was [[Raid on the Nematiec Gang's asteroid base|raided]] by [[Bogga's criminal empire]], and they were defeated by [[Bogga]]'s [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Enforcer One (dreadnaught)|''Enforcer One'']].
